decision.reason: [ev-d7b673b6053f] is a single CHANGELOG line that combines two separate third-party library updates (Vert.x 4.5.14 and Netty 4.1.118.Final). It gives only the new versions, not the previous ones. It says nothing about any behaviour, configuration or compatibility change, which environments are affected, or what happens if an operator does nothing. To write the typed assertion we need artifact diffs or upstream release notes for each dependency that show the prior versions and any effect operators would notice.
